purpose: Estimate a conditional Hog1 activation balance from measured observations and test untouched, within-paper experimental assay/dose holdouts.

model.mechanistic_structure: Published SBML; not discovered by this fitting procedure
model.input_convention: 0.4 M NaCl maps to an added native model osmolarity of 0.8, with linear scaling for the held-out dose
model.growth_input: Published time-dependent optical-density fit remains an imposed input, not a learned growth law

fit.measurement_qualification: Relative Western intensities calibrated using literature abundance and an assumed 90% wild-type phosphorylation peak; not independent absolute phosphorylation measurements
fit.learned_quantity: Activation/deactivation balance relative to the published reference, conditional on fixed fast deactivation and the rest of the published model
fit.observation_gain: A positive least-squares scale estimated from training observations only
fit.objective: Unweighted residuals divided by the training-observation RMS; provided SDs are descriptive, not treated as SEM

parameter_selection_evidence.reason: Both fast rates moved together toward the search ceiling with almost unchanged fit. Minute-sampled data strongly constrain their balance rather than their individual common timescale. The common timescale is therefore held at its published value.

heldouts.source_attestation: Readme!A4 explicitly says these preliminary data were not used for parameter fitting
heldouts.time_interpretation: Caller explicitly accepts relative minutes inferred from publication conventions; S4 time columns themselves are unlabelled
heldouts.measurement_transform: Keep published relative intensities; divide only the identified peak-100 blocks by 100
heldouts.prediction_transform: Normalize each simulated trajectory by its own maximum at that trace's recorded sampling times; do not fit an offset, gain or kinetic parameter to held-out values
heldouts.metric: RMSE of relative time-course shape per trace, then average within measurement block and across blocks
heldouts.replication: Measurement labels and duplicate trace labels are preserved; biological independence is not asserted
baselines: persistent activation after a step input
heldouts.exclusions: No noise-based or outcome-based exclusions; only missing workbook cells are omitted
heldouts.scope: Retrospective measured parameter-fit holdout, not independence from the original model-development process or prospective new-laboratory validation

metabolic_bridge.quantity: Time-matched Gpd1 protein-amount ratio to a zero-NaCl control, using the source model's volume-corrected Gpd1_measured observable
metabolic_bridge.application: Relative available-enzyme capacity for GPD1, subject to existing hard bounds and the shared GEM protein pool
metabolic_bridge.assumptions: Relative protein amount is proportional to catalytic capacity; Gpd1 synthesis/turnover parameters remain source priors, not newly estimated from the Hog1-only fit
not_claimed: Intracellular glycerol equal to secreted glycerol
